info.title: Matomo Reporting API for CustomAlerts plugin

get.description: Calculates the alert value for each site for the given days/weeks/months in past. If the period of the alert is weeks and subPeriodN is "7" it will return the value for the week 7 weeks ago. Set subPeriodN to "0" to test the current day/week/month.

parameters.name: idAlert
parameters.description: Alert ID to evaluate.

parameters.name: subPeriodN
parameters.description: Number of periods in the past to evaluate. Use 0 for the current period.

parameters.name: idAlert
parameters.description: Alert ID to fetch.

get.description: Returns the Alerts that are defined on the idSites given.

parameters.name: idSites
parameters.description: Website ID(s) to query. Accepts comma-separated IDs, "all", numeric IDs as strings, or ["all"].

parameters.name: ifSuperUserReturnAllAlerts
parameters.description: Whether to return all users' alerts when the current user is super user.

200.description: Alerts accessible to the current user.

get.description: Creates an Alert for given website(s).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Alert name.

parameters.name: idSites
parameters.description: Website ID(s) to query. Accepts comma-separated IDs, "all", numeric IDs as strings, or ["all"].

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Alert period. Allowed values: day, week, month.

parameters.name: emailMe
parameters.description: Whether to send email notifications to the current user.

parameters.name: additionalEmails
parameters.description: Additional email recipients.

parameters.name: phoneNumbers
parameters.description: Mobile Messaging recipients.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Metric unique ID (for example nb_uniq_visits, sum_visit_length).

parameters.name: metricCondition
parameters.description: Metric comparison condition. Allowed values: less_than, greater_than, decrease_more_than, increase_more_than, percentage_decrease_more_than, percentage_increase_more_than.

parameters.name: metricValue
parameters.description: Metric to check for the selected report.

parameters.name: comparedTo
parameters.description: Number of prior periods to compare against. Allowed values by period: day => 1, 7, 365; week => 1; month => 1, 12.

parameters.name: reportUniqueId
parameters.description: Report unique ID in format module_action.

parameters.name: reportCondition
parameters.description: Group condition to apply. Allowed values: matches_any, matches_exactly, does_not_match_exactly, matches_regex, does_not_match_regex, contains, does_not_contain, starts_with, does_not_start_with, ends_with, does_not_end_with.

parameters.name: reportValue
parameters.description: Value used by $reportCondition.

parameters.name: reportMediums
parameters.description: Delivery channels. Allowed values: email, mobile, slack, teams.

parameters.name: slackChannelID
parameters.description: Slack channel ID when "slack" medium is enabled.

parameters.name: msTeamsWebhookUrl
parameters.description: Microsoft Teams webhook URL when "teams" medium is enabled.

200.description: ID of the newly created alert.
